test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c14a14da1f1d6d9c66f13ced750d0a2eed5ed5c44ae610133ea89eef81fdd035.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '4', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

Now, Surface '4 and 6' is given in Dice 1 and Dice 3, 

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea62c389c97c62e1d0baf53ab4b8d49203c07b03fc48a4a9282e9d8eab352124.png] 

→ Surface '4 and 6' is the common surface and 1 and 5 is the opposite surface.

So, the remaining '5' will be the opposite face of '1'.

And, From Dice 2 and Dice 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36a07883c231b130360e3f495db02e288623af15917253a90a92dbcbe0426c20.png] 

Here, no common surfaces in Dice 2 and 3, so from clockwise/anticlockwise rotation,

The opposite surface will be:

1 ⇔ 5

2 ⇔ 6

3 ⇔ 4

So, '3' will be the opposite face of '4'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
